title: AgentLink
tagline: AgentLink enables seamless blockchain transactions via SMS & WhatsApp—send funds, mint NFTs, and deploy smart contracts without an app! Built on Base Chain with Coinbase AgentKit, Gaia Node LLM, and AVS Eigen Layer for security. Blockchain for everyone, anywhere!
description:
AgentLink is an AI-powered messaging agent that enables users to interact with blockchain networks using SMS and WhatsApp. Built on Base Chain and powered by Coinbase AgentKit, it allows users to send funds, mint NFTs, deploy smart contracts, and manage on-chain transactions—all through simple text-based communication. By integrating Gaia Node’s LLM for AI processing and AVS Eigen Layer for decentralized validation, AgentLink ensures secure and seamless blockchain interactions. This approach eliminates the need for complex apps, making Web3 accessible to users even in low-connectivity regions.

Unlike most blockchain bots that rely on Telegram, AgentLink brings decentralized finance (DeFi) to billions of WhatsApp and SMS users, especially in regions with limited internet access. Users can perform on-chain transactions, deploy smart contracts, and automate Web3 actions with a simple message. The system processes requests using AI, executes transactions on Base Chain, and validates them through AVS Eigen Layer, ensuring security and trust. By bridging familiar communication tools with advanced blockchain functionalities, AgentLink is driving mass adoption of Web3 technology—without the need for specialized knowledge or additional apps.
how_its_made:
AgentLink is built using a combination of blockchain, AI, and messaging technologies, integrating Coinbase AgentKit, Base Chain, Gaia Node LLM, and AVS Eigen Layer to enable secure Web3 transactions via SMS and WhatsApp. When a user sends a message, Gaia Node’s LLM processes the request, extracts intent, and formats it for execution. Coinbase AgentKit then interacts with Base Chain to execute on-chain transactions such as fund transfers, NFT minting, and smart contract deployment. To ensure trust and security, AVS Eigen Layer provides Active Validation Services (AVS), leveraging decentralized restaking mechanisms to validate transactions independently, preventing fraud and enhancing reliability.

For messaging, Twilio for SMS and the WhatsApp Business API handle user interactions, ensuring smooth communication without requiring additional apps. A unique aspect of AgentLink is its multi-layer fallback mechanism, which automatically switches between WhatsApp and SMS based on network conditions, ensuring uninterrupted blockchain access. AI-driven error handling and retry logic optimize transaction efficiency, reducing failures due to minor input mistakes. By merging Web3 infrastructure with traditional messaging, AgentLink creates an accessible, secure, and intuitive blockchain experience for users worldwide. 🚀
